{{Top|leg}}
'''Satyn''' was a textile used in the construction of semi-formal apparel. It was a lightweight fabric that had a sheen or shiny appearance on its exterior surface.{{Fact}}

[[Lando Calrissian/Legends|Lando Calrissian]] had at least one pair of blue satyn uniform trousers, as well as a stylish satyn semiformal cummerbund.<ref name="Mindharp of Sharu">''[[Lando Calrissian and the Mindharp of Sharu]]''</ref> A customs agent on [[Dilonexa XXIII]] wore deep green bib overalls of heavily creased satyn.<ref name="Flamewind of Oseon">''[[Lando Calrissian and the Flamewind of Oseon]]''</ref>
